label: Ostkaka
note: Hälsinge ostkaka is pressed and smooth, almost halloumi-like; Småland ostkaka is soft-grained, with cream, eggs and almonds. Not American cheesecake

about.text: Ostkaka is a Swedish curd cake from Hälsingland and Småland, traditionally made from raw milk and rennet. The set curd is drained, baked, and eaten tepid with jam, cloudberries and cream.
